# Project Lantern

Project Lantern maps light pollution over the coast at night and tracks how
dark the sky stays for migrating birds.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[oskar-lindqvist]] and runs from [[brask-station]].
Night flights carry the [[lidar-pod-lp3]].
